proof:
Source: step 0 and the Notation paragraph of the parent proof:
- Q_δ is open, convex and bounded;
- |x − y| ≤ √n·s with s = 1 − 2δ ≤ 1;
- under the measure-preserving coordinate map Euclid n → (Fin n → ℝ), Q_δ corresponds to the box ∏_i (δ, 1 − δ).

Only the coarser consequences ‖x − y‖ ≤ √n and Lⁿ(Q_δ) ≤ 1 are recorded. They hold for every δ ≥ 0, so the parent's case distinction δ ≥ 1/2 (empty cube) is not needed.

Notation. Q_δ := {z ∈ Euclid n : δ < z_i < 1 − δ for all i}, where z_i = z.ofLp i is the i-th coordinate. Lⁿ := volume on Euclid n.

1. Convexity. By convex_iff_forall_pos it suffices to take x, y ∈ Q_δ and a, b > 0 with a + b = 1. For each i, (a·x + b·y)_i = a·x_i + b·y_i, and
   a·x_i + b·y_i − δ = a(x_i − δ) + b(y_i − δ) > 0,
   (1 − δ) − (a·x_i + b·y_i) = a(1 − δ − x_i) + b(1 − δ − y_i) > 0,
   since each term is a product of two positive numbers. Hence a·x + b·y ∈ Q_δ.
2. Measurability. Q_δ = ⋂_i ({z : δ < z_i} ∩ {z : z_i < 1 − δ}). Each coordinate map z ↦ z_i is continuous, hence measurable, so each set {z : δ < z_i} and {z : z_i < 1 − δ} is measurable (measurableSet_lt). The finite intersection is then measurable (MeasurableSet.iInter, MeasurableSet.inter).
3. Diameter. Let x, y ∈ Q_δ. For each i, δ < x_i, y_i < 1 − δ gives −1 ≤ −(1 − 2δ) < x_i − y_i < 1 − 2δ ≤ 1 (using δ ≥ 0), so (x_i − y_i)² ≤ 1. Hence ‖x − y‖ = √(∑_i (x_i − y_i)²) ≤ √(∑_i 1) = √n (EuclideanSpace.norm_eq and monotonicity of √).
4. Volume. As δ ≥ 0, every z ∈ Q_δ has 0 ≤ δ < z_i < 1 − δ ≤ 1. So Q_δ ⊆ ofLp⁻¹(∏_i (0, 1)), where ofLp : Euclid n → (Fin n → ℝ) is the coordinate map and ∏_i (0, 1) = univ.pi (fun _ => Ioo 0 1) is a measurable box. ofLp is measure preserving (PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp), so
   Lⁿ(Q_δ) ≤ Lⁿ(ofLp⁻¹(∏_i (0, 1))) = vol(∏_i (0, 1)) = ∏_i ofReal(1 − 0) = 1
   (Real.volume_pi_Ioo; for n = 0 the empty product is 1). ∎

theorem Submission.cmcdt_cbm_sp_cube_geometry : ∀ (n : ℕ) (δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ → Convex ℝ {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ} ∧ MeasurableSet {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ} ∧ (∀ x ∈ {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ∀ y ∈ {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ‖x - y‖ ≤ Real.sqrt n) ∧ volume {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ} ≤ 1 := by
  intro n δ hδ
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine convex_iff_forall_pos.2 fun x hx y hy a b ha hb hab i => ?_
    have hxi := hx i
    have hyi := hy i
    simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
    subst hb'
    constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_pos ha (sub_pos.2 hxi.1), mul_pos hb (sub_pos.2 hyi.1)]
    · nlinarith [mul_pos ha (sub_pos.2 hxi.2), mul_pos hb (sub_pos.2 hyi.2)]
  · have hc : ∀ i : Fin n, Continuous fun z : Euclid n => z i := fun i => by fun_prop
    have : {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ} =
        ⋂ i, ({z : Euclid n | δ < z i} ∩ {z : Euclid n | z i < 1 - δ}) := by
      ext z; simp
    rw [this]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i =>
      (measurableSet_lt measurable_const (hc i).measurable).inter
        (measurableSet_lt (hc i).measurable measurable_const)
  · intro x hx y hy
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    calc ∑ i, ‖(x - y) i‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, (1 : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i _
          have hxi := hx i
          have hyi := hy i
          simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
          nlinarith
      _ = n := by simp
  · have hsub : {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ} ⊆
        WithLp.ofLp ⁻¹' (Set.univ.pi fun _ : Fin n => Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      intro z hz
      simp only [mem_preimage, mem_univ_pi, mem_Ioo]
      intro i
      exact ⟨by linarith [(hz i).1], by linarith [(hz i).2]⟩
    calc volume {z : Euclid n | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}
        ≤ volume (WithLp.ofLp ⁻¹' (Set.univ.pi fun _ : Fin n => Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) : Set (Euclid n)) :=
          measure_mono hsub
      _ = volume (Set.univ.pi fun _ : Fin n => Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
          (PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp (Fin n)).measure_preimage
            (MeasurableSet.univ_pi fun _ => measurableSet_Ioo).nullMeasurableSet
      _ = 1 := by rw [Real.volume_pi_Ioo]; simp
key_steps: Convexity: coordinatewise a(x_i − δ) + b(y_i − δ) > 0, and the analogous upper inequality, for a, b > 0 with a + b = 1.
Measurability: finite intersection of the sets {δ < z_i} and {z_i < 1 − δ} given by continuous coordinates.
Volume: Q_δ ⊆ ofLp⁻¹(∏(0, 1)); ofLp is measure preserving and vol(∏(0, 1)) = 1.
